title: Update AppRoot with folder gating logic
description: Modify CookbookApp/AppRoot.swift. Inject/observe RecipesFolderStore (instantiated once at the app level). When resolvedFolderURL is nil, render FolderSetupView full-screen with no tab bar. When resolvedFolderURL is non-nil, render the existing TabView shell. The branch re-evaluates reactively so the transition from setup view to tab bar happens without a manual app restart.
acceptance_criteria: nil resolvedFolderURL renders FolderSetupView with no tab bar.
Non-nil resolvedFolderURL renders the TabView shell.
Transition from FolderSetupView to tab bar is reactive (no app restart needed).
RecipesFolderStore is instantiated once at app level.
